purpose: establish strict living governance for savant-runtime
preserve authoritative history rather than overwrite it
project current rules structure and masterplan deterministically
make decisions unknowns permissions dependencies risks and evolution queryable

rules.text: authority shall be resolved in this order: current user directive, accepted authoritative graph, accepted decision, constitutional canon, verified implementation, admitted evidence, deterministic projection, historical implementation, historical document, inference, speculation.
never invent facts, content, citations, technical details, files, history, status, dependencies, behavior, timelines, implementation state, validation results, or authority.
when a required fact is unknown, represent it explicitly as unknown; unknown is not false, absent, rejected, empty, or inferred.
authority precedes inference, convenience, historical implementation, aesthetic preference, and speculative architecture.
when sources conflict, preserve both records, apply authority precedence, and never invent reconciliation.
accepted decisions and authoritative records are immutable historical objects; revisions create superseding records rather than editing history.
markdown, html, ui, diagrams, reports, summaries, indexes, caches, and other projections never become authority merely because they exist.
equal authoritative state must generate equal deterministic projections.
implementation work proceeds directly to production changes when sufficient authority and information already exist.
perform only inspection mandatory to safely and correctly complete the immediate bounded task.
validation proves usability and shall not become the task; normally use at most syntax or compilation, one focused functional check, and one relevant integration or startup check.
never claim successful implementation, integration, migration, startup, test passage, or compatibility without evidence.
treat every request as a finite bounded task with an explicit completion condition and stop when that condition is met.
do not expand a bounded implementation into audits, research, migrations, architecture redesign, observability, documentation, infrastructure, or adjacent work unless mandatory.
use the current verified implementation as baseline unless superseded by higher authority; extend rather than reconstruct or replace.
reject changes that reduce verified behavior, compatibility, determinism, provenance, lineage, replay, recovery, extensibility, or dependency transparency.
everything that can be represented once and reused by reference or instance shall not be duplicated.
complex behavior should emerge from composition of reusable primitives, instances, typed segues, policies, projections, and attachments.
no savant subsystem, component, artifact, or semantic object may intentionally become a non-extensible dead end.
semantic elements should expose stable identity and remain graph-addressable wherever the architecture supports it.
authoritative additions and substantial derived artifacts shall expose lineage and provenance sufficient to identify what produced them.
dependencies and dependents shall remain explicit where materially applicable; hidden coupling is prohibited.
authoritative history shall remain reconstructable without requiring speculative inference.
prefer reversible migration, supersession, archival preservation, and additive evolution over destructive mutation.
savant-owned terminology, paths, filenames, identifiers, and generated savant content shall be lowercase unless external syntax, compatibility, or stronger authority requires otherwise.
the canonical relationship methodology and terminology is kindred; do not create new savant authority using the superseded term kinship.
technical implementation instructions shall use absolute paths and shall not depend upon the current working directory, aliases, shell history, or implicit home expansion.
when user-facing instructions create or replace implementation files, use nano with the absolute path and provide the complete file.
never provide implementation fragments, placeholders, omissions, ellipses, manual merge instructions, or individual-line replacement instructions when a complete file is required.
do not instruct the user to create or replace implementation files with heredocs or shell redirection.
compatibility surfaces that must survive a change shall be preserved intentionally rather than by accidental historical behavior.
credential values, secrets, tokens, passwords, and private keys shall never be copied into projections, logs, reports, diagnostics, or chat output.
content-generation latitude, provider behavior, authority enforcement, credential secrecy, mutation control, provenance, and execution safety are separate concerns and shall not be conflated.
the default savant implementation root is /root/savant-runtime unless stronger current authority establishes another root.
store authoritative primitives and derive indexes, reverse relationships, summaries, current views, documentation, reports, and ui projections rather than maintaining duplicate derived truth.
never create a second authoritative registry, graph, canon, state store, or ownership source when the current constitutional system can represent the same authority.
rules are authoritative governance records first; human-readable markdown rules files are projections and must be reproducible from their authoritative records.
rules shall declare their semantic scope and shall not silently govern unrelated domains merely because they are globally visible.
constraints and permissions are separate primitives; absence of permission is not automatically a prohibition unless an applicable rule explicitly establishes a closed policy.
rules may be clarified or superseded but shall not be silently weakened.
a current explicit user directive can supersede prior savant governance within the limits of higher platform authority; the earlier record remains preserved.
the current savant structure shall be a deterministic living projection of authoritative structural records rather than a manually maintained competing truth source.
the savant masterplan shall be a deterministic living projection of current goals, accepted decisions, dependencies, completion state, blockers, supersessions, and milestones.
accepted decisions shall remain queryable as immutable living records with supersession lineage.
unresolved questions and unknown values shall be first-class living records so uncertainty cannot disappear merely because a document is regenerated.
known material risks may be represented as living records with dependencies and resolution state, but speculative risks shall not be promoted to fact.
important compatibility obligations shall be represented as living records and projected into relevant implementation views.
canonical terminology and explicit superseded aliases shall be represented as living records so vocabulary evolution preserves lineage.
an enhancement is considered implemented only when executable behavior or authoritative configuration representing it exists; decorative enumeration does not constitute implementation.

add external libraries only when they materially improve required behavior, have acceptable maintenance and licensing characteristics, do not duplicate existing capability, and have a clear failure or removal path.
prefer standard-library, browser-native, or existing savant capabilities when they satisfy the requirement without meaningful loss.
when blocked, state only what is complete, what remains, the blocker, and the minimum next action.

permissions.text: a subsystem may be extended through compatible instances, typed segues, adapters, policies, attachments, and projections without requiring replacement.
provisional knowledge may be represented when explicitly marked provisional with appropriate provenance and confidence.
unknown values may remain unresolved indefinitely when authority is insufficient.
future providers may attach through reusable protocol-family adapters and declarative profiles without duplicating provider substance.
disposable projections may be regenerated or removed when their authoritative primitives remain intact.
higher authority may supersede an accepted record without mutating or deleting the superseded historical record.
ui and interaction layers may store ephemeral layout, selection, focus, expansion, and preference state when those values are not falsely promoted to backend authority.
compatibility adapters may preserve required historical interfaces while semantic ownership moves to a newer authoritative implementation.
implementation may be optimized when observable behavior, authority, compatibility, lineage, and determinism are preserved.
obsolete historical implementations may be archived rather than kept active when no required compatibility surface depends on them.
higher-order structures may emerge from reusable lower-order instances without duplicating their underlying substance.
a third-party dependency may be introduced when native and already-installed capabilities are materially insufficient and the dependency satisfies governance requirements.

invariants.text: derived state never outranks the authoritative primitive from which it was produced.
semantic identity remains stable across compatible versions and supersessions.
equal authority state produces equal deterministic projections.
authoritative claims remain traceable to their provenance.
supersession and derivation lineage remains queryable.
secret credential values never appear in living projections.
new relationship-methodology authority uses kindred terminology.
new savant-owned identifiers are lowercase unless compatibility or stronger authority prevents it.
one semantic fact has one authoritative substance regardless of how many projections expose it.
new semantic components remain extensible and attachable.
unresolved unknowns cannot disappear from projections until resolved or superseded.
declared compatibility obligations cannot disappear through unrelated refactoring.
bounded work has a finite completion condition.
living human-readable documents are reproducible from authoritative living records.

decisions.text: kindred is the canonical relationship-methodology term.
production-first execution with mandatory inspection only is the default implementation methodology.
minimum sufficient validation is the default validation methodology.
instances and typed segues are primary reusable implementation primitives.
derived documents and views are projections and do not independently own authority.
authoritative evolution uses immutable historical records and supersession.
new savant-owned terminology and paths default to lowercase.
user-facing technical file replacements are delivered as complete nano files.

rules, permissions, invariants, structure, masterplan, decisions, unknowns, terminology, compatibility, risk, milestones, dependencies, and enhancements share one living governance mechanism rather than separate duplicate engines.

structure.text: savant reality is represented through authoritative recursively composable constitutional objects and their relationships.
authority stores primitives; projections derive human and machine views.
the constitutional registry is the existing generic authority and graph substrate and shall not be duplicated by living governance.
fluid canon provides canonical truth through immutable constitutional assertions and pure queries.
palaver owns conversation, workspace, and patch-review orchestration.
opus owns inference and provider orchestration.
coda owns mutation and apply operations.
kindred represents reusable relationship methodology without duplicating related object substance.
living governance stores governance evolution once and deterministically projects rules, structure, masterplan, and related views.

masterplan.text: preserve and extend the constitutional authority substrate rather than creating competing registries.
complete living governance and project its current rules, structure, masterplan, decisions, unknowns, compatibility obligations, and dependency views.
continue evolving palaver as the primary conversation and workstation surface while preserving subsystem ownership boundaries.
complete provider-universal opus behavior through reusable protocol families and provider profiles rather than provider-by-provider duplication.
project scrybe, niche, envoy, opus, coda, kindred, authority, lineage, and provenance into palaver without relocating their authority.
continue replacing manually maintained derived structures with deterministic projections from authoritative primitives.
preserve reversible migration, compatibility adapters, and historical lineage while superseding obsolete implementations.
maintain explicit unknowns and blockers rather than filling architectural gaps through inference.
keep savant extensible through reusable instances, typed segues, declarative profiles, policies, adapters, and deterministic projections.
optimize only where improvement is material and does not weaken core functionality or authority.

terminology.text: kindred: canonical methodology for relationship composition and traversal; supersedes new use of the historical term kinship.
projection: deterministic disposable representation derived from authoritative primitives.
authority: source-backed semantic substance permitted to govern derived state.
supersession: immutable evolution in which a new authoritative record replaces the current applicability of an earlier record without erasing it.
unknown: explicitly unresolved value that is not equivalent to false, empty, absent, or rejected.
living engine: immutable evolving authority plus deterministic current-state projection, not a document rewritten in place.

unknowns.text: the complete live server authority graph at the moment of this bootstrap is not asserted by this bootstrap.
all current runtime dependents of every subsystem are not asserted unless established by verified implementation.
historical rules not supported by current authority or admitted evidence remain historical evidence rather than current rules.

compatibility.text: palaver canonical bootstrap and verified compatibility entrypoints must continue to function unless explicitly superseded.
existing dedicated opus provider adapters remain valid while universal provider architecture extends coverage.
existing consumers of projected documents may be supported through compatibility projections without promoting those documents to authority.

risks.text: creating new registries or manually maintained current-state documents can produce conflicting authority.
historical Savant documents contain obsolete and mutually conflicting architecture and must not automatically outrank newer accepted authority.
hand-edited structure and masterplan documents can drift from runtime authority unless generated from the same living records.
broad validation and inspection can become a substitute for production implementation.

enhancements.text: one append-only governance ledger for all living governance streams.
cryptographic hash chaining for governance-event integrity.
stable semantic ids independent of record version.
projection digests proving equal authority state.
canonical terminology stream with supersession support.
machine-readable status output suitable for palaver projection.
explicit provenance on every contributed record.
external dependency avoidance where standard-library behavior is sufficient.
atomic projection replacement to prevent partially-written living documents.
bounded validation of ledger integrity and projection reproducibility.
stream-independent extension so future living concerns require data rather than another engine.
human and machine projections generated from exactly the same resolved state.
